title: Report the first malformed Unicode subsequence
goal: Locate invalid UTF-8 or UTF-16 input with offsets in the original encoding before decoding or transforming it.

selectionNotes: Offsets count UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units. A partial trailing token is invalid only at the actual end of input.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses .NET 11 library APIs; the .NET 10 code is a comparison, not a catalogue route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 sample with the .NET 11 SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical net11.0 project selects the .NET 11 default C# 15 language mode.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: A trailing partial UTF-8 sequence or unmatched high surrogate is invalid when the input is complete. For streaming input retain incomplete trailing data until the next block instead of treating every block as a complete document. These functions validate encoding, not normalization, grapheme boundaries, application allowlists or display safety. Return the offset in its original units: the test places an invalid byte at 5 after a four-byte scalar, and an unmatched surrogate at UTF-16 offset 3 after a surrogate pair.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.

evidence.scope: Actual UnicodeText compilation and focused execution on Windows. No mocks, cross-compilation, native deployment or GA proof.
